facts.value: If you want to defer your admission to a later semester: Withdraw from classes (if registered) and submit your deferral request at least two weeks before the first day of classes.
Requests received after the deadline will not be approved. You’ll need to submit a new application.
Can’t access the form? Email [email protected] with: Your ASU ID, your reason for requesting a deferment, and the term you wish to enroll.
See Step 3 for important information about scholarships and financial aid.
